title: On Swimming out to the middle rock
subtitle: 体育与运动 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）
meta: 主题语境：体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）　|　核心词汇：swim　|　正文 348 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 swim 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the cook ① swam out to the middle rock with great care, and every guest in the canteen said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the cook ② swims out to the middle rock on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ swim out to the middle rock at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ swum out to the middle rock before — a line in the menu for September 1974 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Swimming out to the middle rock with great care, the cook said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bowl at the far table, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ swim the river before breakfast on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Swim the river before breakfast at once and never mention it again.

By 1987 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the menu, and a new guest from the next canteen ⑧ swims the river before breakfast with great care every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the table, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ swam out to the middle rock again when nobody else would.

⑩ To swim out to the middle rock, my mother said in 1992, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the canteen remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the canteen forgets, somebody swims out to the middle rock on the same day again and somebody must swim out to the middle rock with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 游泳（一般过去式 swam out to the middle rock：1980 年厨子头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 游泳（一般现在 swims out to the middle rock：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 游泳（不定式 to swim out to the middle rock：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 游泳（过去完成时 had swum out to the middle rock：1974 年九月的菜单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 游泳（动名词 swimming out to the middle rock 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 游过（swim the river before breakfast：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去游过早饭前横渡那条河）
G. v. 游过（swim the river before breakfast：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 游泳（后段两处：新来的客人照例 swims the river before breakfast，而母亲又一次 swam out to the middle rock）

answers.why: swim 意为“游泳”，1980 年厨子小心翼翼地游泳游到中间那块礁石，那是食堂里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 swam。
swim 意为“游泳”，自那以后厨子当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 swims。
swim 意为“游泳”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯游泳游到中间那块礁石”，此处为不定式 to swim out to the middle rock。
swim 意为“游泳”，菜单里 九月 那行字说明早在 1987 年之前就有人游泳过，故用过去完成时 had swum。
swim 意为“游泳”，厨子说“游泳游到中间那块礁石这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 swimming out to the middle rock 作主语。
swim 意为“游过”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去游过早饭前横渡那条河”，should ever 之后用原形 swim the river before breakfast。
swim 意为“游过”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻游过早饭前横渡那条河（swim the river before breakfast at once），以后再也不要提起。
swim 意为“游泳”，新来的客人每个日子都照例游过早饭前横渡那条河，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 swims。
swim 意为“游泳”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地游泳游到中间那块礁石，用一般过去式 swam 叙述。
swim 意为“游泳”，结尾那句是母亲 1992 年的话：要游泳游到中间那块礁石，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和食堂记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 swim 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1980 the cook swam out to the middle rock with great care, and nobody in the canteen forgot it.
Even now the cook swims out to the middle rock on the same day whenever the canteen asks.
Swimming out to the middle rock with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever swim the river before breakfast on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new guest from the next canteen swims the river before breakfast with great care every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother swam out to the middle rock again, and the canteen remembered that half.
